title: Fréchet Regression on the Bures-Wasserstein Manifold
summary: Fréchet regression, or conditional Barycenters, is a flexible framework for modeling relationships between covariates (usually Euclidean) and response variables on general metric spaces, e.g., probability distributions or positive definite matrices. However, in contrast to classical barycenter problems, computing conditional counterparts in many non-Euclidean spaces remains an open challenge, as they yield non-convex optimization problems with an affine structure.
